needed.evidence: No continuous sidewalk; only a grassy verge and a trodden strip beside the road.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous 1.5 m paved footway on the left, set back from the carriageway edge.

needed.evidence: No usable footway; the roadside is a fence and open ground with no pedestrian path.
needed.suggestion: Provide a 1.5 m paved footway on the right, separated from the road by a kerb.

needed.evidence: Homes and a shopfront on both sides create crossing demand, but no marked or signalised crossing is visible.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with high-visibility markings at the junction of the side road.

needed.evidence: No crossing exists, so there are no dropped kerbs to assist pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Add dropped kerbs at both ends of the new marked crossing.

needed.evidence: Only a few distant poles are visible; the stretch is not adequately lit for night use.
needed.suggestion: Install a line of street lights along both sides of the road at roughly 40 m spacing.
